message.text: Made from the VS Code tab. Every card should show where the thing stands in as few words as possible: its name, its state, what is done and what is next, and the actual objects (instances, hierarchy) instead of paragraphs.

Fixed: the AI 2 rail hid any card filed in a group, so both new cards were folded away. A card active in the last half hour now stays in the rail as its own row, so both show at the top of the card list, below the group rows. The group label on the row is not done, and the rest of the rail work still needs its own agent.

The design is ready, with a picture of the Servex card drawn to the new standard: /framework/ai/2026-09-25/servex-mastermind/. Every card gets a one-line state, its live objects in one shared widget, a checklist, and links, and a script checks each card when its task lands. The build brief is five pieces in /framework/ai/todo.md under "Cards that show the thing", ready to dispatch.

What this card is: a folder, public/framework/ai/2026/09/25/cards-that-show-the-thing/. Its page.jsonl is the card: one line per event, and the latest line wins. Servex wrote line 1 when I called create_card, then a group line (AI dashboard), then these messages. AI 2 lists every card through Servex (GET /cards) and reads each card's page.jsonl; nothing else stores it. I also wrote about.md with a checklist and placed it, but the AI 2 card view doesn't draw placed files yet (being fixed). It sat far down because the list isn't newest-first yet (also being fixed).

Being fixed, first in line (task-mastermind-layout-check): the list becomes one sort, newest activity on top, with a time on every row. A new card lands at the very top. The ~355 old migrated cards leave the main list and move to an Archive link at the bottom. The default list shows only the last 2 days, anything open or working, and the groups.

Now in CLAUDE.md: show it with the widget first (files through ext/files, objects live, tasks as a checklist), words last; and route everything. Being fixed by task-mastermind-page-system: swapped docs get their own URL, the about page gets padding, the Back icon lines up, and every card shows its folder with ext/files.
Taken: routing, padding, Back icon and the files widget are with one Sonnet minion now, ahead of docs. One line per fix will land here as each is proven headless with before/after shots.

The card standard now says "show it, then say it": a card's folder in the file widget, its live objects, its tasks as a checklist, with words last, and every view on its own URL. It's written at /framework/ai2/doc/card-standard.md. The four agents that write cards (the fast assistant, the card assistant, the manager, finish-task) now start with it. The design page shows the files first: /framework/ai/2026-09-25/servex-mastermind/

Every agent that writes for you now follows the content skill: finish-task, the manager, and the front desk load it, and the two assistants have the rule written in. Each landing now flags walls of text; yesterday's loose-ends report (1,091 words) would have been caught. The card standard is now a picture plus an outline: /framework/ai2/doc/card-standard.md

1 Routing: a doc opened in a card now changes the URL (.../md/about/), and a reload or Back lands on it. 2 Padding: the swapped-in doc has side padding, using the existing pad class, no new CSS. 3 Back icon: aligned. 4 Files: each card draws its own folder with the file widget, and place lines now draw on the card. Live now; card.js also carries another agent's unsaved edits, which I merged by hand and did not commit.

The clarity agent is live: a fresh Sonnet checks every landing and every proposal, and rewrites what isn't clear. Its first real rewrite turned a 709-word report into a table plus bullets for $0.20. Its log: .claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl
AI 2, step by step (press Next): /framework/ai/2026-09-25/ai2-lead/ . Linked at the top of this card, too.
